subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage stack as the future token-accounting architecture, and if so, which fork identity and cache-invalidation behavior should be retained from https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: The patch is well-tested and reversible, but choosing between or combining two overlapping accounting designs affects permanent scanner complexity, compatibility, and the meaning of persisted historical totals.

options.title: Reconcile and land the stack
options.body: Review the four lineage PRs in order, incorporate the compatible narrow identity/cache fixes, and keep lineage shadowed or explicitly authorized until more finalized validation passes.

options.title: Land the narrow fix first
options.body: Prioritize https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 for the immediate overcount and cache problem while leaving the lineage architecture experimental.

options.title: Pause the rearchitecture
options.body: Retain current-main containment and defer the lineage stack until additional datasets establish acceptable daily accuracy and long-term maintenance value.

recommendation.title: Reconcile and land the stack
recommendation.body: Review the four lineage PRs in order, incorporate the compatible narrow identity/cache fixes, and keep lineage shadowed or explicitly authorized until more finalized validation passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice determines CodexBar’s permanent scanner architecture and the landing order of multiple overlapping external contributions.
